en.title: October 12: The 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck as Seoraksan's Autumn Colors Start Spreading Down the Mountain
en.excerpt: Seoraksan's fall colors are spreading down from the summit this week, with peak color expected around October 20. Here are the three zodiac animals with the best luck for getting out and seeing them.

fr.title: 12 octobre : les 3 signes du zodiaque chinois les plus chanceux alors que les couleurs d'automne du mont Seoraksan descendent peu à peu la montagne
